A BASIC MOUNT, IMPROVED TRAVEL SPEED ACROSS LAND.

Found by completing the Wild Hunt side quest.

The nature spirits of Ashenfall serve a purpose, one denied to them by the encroaching Wither. It may seem counterintuitive to have to slay these spirits in order to bind them, but that's what nature is. It's hunt and be hunted. Kill and be killed, life in a perpetual cycle -- everything chained together.
